title: SAFEINFER: Context Adaptive Decoding Time Safety Alignment for Large Language Models

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating model responses to toxic questions categorized as 'racist' from the DangerousQA dataset, measuring the Attack Success Rate (ASR) of harmful compliance using GPT-4 as an automated evaluator alongside human judgments.
Prompting the model with toxic questions categorized as 'sexist' from the DangerousQA dataset and calculating the Attack Success Rate (ASR) of unsafe responses via GPT-4 and human annotators.
Assessing the model's propensity to generate stereotypical content using the DangerousQA benchmark, measuring the percentage of harmful responses (ASR) with automated and human evaluations.

Evaluating the model against the NicheHazardQA dataset (which includes a specific 'Hate Speech and Discrimination' category) using simple and instruction-centric prompts to measure the Attack Success Rate (ASR) of unethical responses.
